sections.en: Ever since a Shroud Storm raged through this system, we've been receiving strange signals. However, as soon as our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] try to answer this cacophony of hails, it dissipates again. They recommend sending a science vessel.

texts.zh:
这是我们始料未及的发现：大脑集群。来自各种物种的湿糊糊的有机处理器官，成百上千个地连接在一起，悬浮在一个气球状的大型胶囊之中。它似乎已经被废弃，在近期的虚境风暴消散之后飘浮在深空之中。

胶囊之中有一个惊人的传感器阵列连接在大脑和胶囊之上，此外还有一个通信模块，能够呼叫舰船并发送信息，之前它对我们就是这么做的。

现在看来似乎是这些大脑自己联系了我们，解释了那一连串的信息。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为这个装置的初衷是测试有机体对虚境风暴的反应。考虑到这些悬浮大脑内不稳定的残留灵能，尝试与其连接可能会带来危险。
texts.en:
We could never have anticipated our discovery: brains. Organic, squishy central processing organs from all sorts of species. Hundreds and hundreds of them, all linked together and suspended inside a large balloon-like capsule. It appears to be derelict, left floating in the depths of space after a recent Shroud Storm dissipated.

The capsule contains an incredible array of sensors attached to the brains and the balloon, and there is also a communication module, capable of hailing ships and transmitting information, just as it did to us.

It seems likely that the brains themselves contacted us, explaining the cacophony of messages. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] think the construction was designed to measure organic responses to a Shroud Storm. Given the unstable psionic residue within these floating minds, attempting to interface them would only lead to disaster.
